methodology:
PT Astra Agro Lestari is one of Indonesia's largest palm oil pure-plays with ~287K hectares (~709K acres) across 4 major regional clusters: Sumatra (core, oldest plantings), Central Kalimantan (largest single cluster by area), South+East Kalimantan, and Sulawesi.

The 4-row breakdown reflects regional pricing variation:
- Sumatra: IDR 80M/acre — premium for mill density + port proximity
- Central Kalimantan: IDR 70M/acre — slight logistics discount
- South + East Kalimantan: IDR 65M/acre  
- Sulawesi: IDR 60M/acre — furthest from major CPO export ports

All values per-acre × IDR FX from ~$4-5K USD/acre baseline. Book values allocated by area share of Net PP&E (IDR 17.4 trillion total). The 4-cluster split is more granular than the prior 2-row aggregation but still aggregates AALI's individual estates within each cluster.
